title: The Rooftop Protocol
premise: Elena Vance confronts Victor Cross on a rainy rooftop about a breached encryption protocol.
visual_style: photorealistic cinematic film still, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, cool teal night grade

scenes.title: The Rooftop
scenes.location: the flat concrete rooftop of a downtown office tower at night, wet with rain, a low parapet, glowing city skyline and distant neon signs behind
scenes.action_summary: Elena finds Victor waiting on the rooftop and accuses him.
scenes.music_description: low cello drone, slow distant pulse, sparse piano notes

shots.action_description: Elena Vance steps out of the stairwell door onto the wet rooftop and walks slowly toward the camera through the rain, her coat moving in the wind
shots.sound_description: Steady rain on concrete, wind gusts, distant city traffic, her footsteps splashing

shots.action_description: Elena Vance stops, raindrops on her face, looks straight into the camera with cold certainty and speaks

dialogue.text: You knew the encryption was already breached, Victor.

shots.sound_description: Rain on concrete, wind, distant thunder

shots.action_description: Victor Cross, standing under the rain by the parapet, adjusts his signet ring, looks into the camera with a faint smile and answers

dialogue.text: Breached? No, Elena. It was designed to open.

shots.sound_description: Rain on concrete, wind, a distant siren
